pages.text: [#](53341a)Some witches redraw whole circles by hand; richer or lazier ones persuade the circle to rewrite itself. This changes an existing ring from one chalk family to another — it retunes marks already there.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Glyphic Transformation

pages.text: [#](53341a)Offer the chalk family you want — **Chalk**, **Otherwhere Chalk**, or **Infernal Chalk** — plus **Gypsum**, an **Arthana**, and **1000 altar power**. The Arthana returns.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)The amount of dropped chalk decides which ring is rewritten: one for small, two for medium, three for large.[#]()
